description: Popular-tags cache: one module-level slot ignores the caller's user id, so one user's personalized tag list is served to everyone for five minutes.
notes: FM-12 (caching and staleness). getTags(id) is personalized: it returns tags from demo authors OR the caller's own articles. The new cache is a single module-level slot keyed on nothing, so the first caller's list (including tags from their own non-demo articles, which other users can't see) is served to every user, signed in or not, until the TTL expires; the cache key is missing the `id` input. Severity important: FM-12 grades important (wrong data shown); the exposure is tag names only, not an exploit. Fix: key the cache by user id (or cache only the anonymous result and skip the cache when id is set). The TTL and tests are legitimate.
